subject: Maps from Feeds
author: senocular
body: The open in a new window thing was actually a bug in the map.  That shouldn't be necessary and it should always load. It should be fixed now. :)

subject: More races!
author: Xandu
body:
I've added 4 new races today. Subscribe to the feed here: http://feeds.feedburner.com/BurnoutParadiseRaces. Clicking the race links in the feed will take you to the map of the race (if the map is empty make sure that you open the link in a new window). You can also see all the races here.

-- The Creator --
